method.method_draft: First describe the circuit from the image, naming the a-node, the upper middle node T, and the right vertical node X. Apply a 1 V test source between a and b, taking Va = 1 V and Vb = 0 V. Write KCL at T through R1, R3, and R2: (VT - Va)/R1 + (VT - Va)/R3 + (VT - VX)/R2 = 0. Write KCL at X through R2, R4, and R5: (VX - VT)/R2 + (VX - Va)/R4 + (VX - Vb)/R5 = 0. Substitute the given resistor values to solve for VT and VX, then compute the total current drawn from the test source through R1, R3, and R4: Itest = (Va - VT)/R1 + (Va - VT)/R3 + (Va - VX)/R4. The solved current is 1/3 A for a 1 V test, so Req = 1/(1/3) = 3 ohm.
